claims.statement: The orders domain uses a two-level payment model: the Trade entity (trade table, string trade_id PK) is the payment ticket with trade_state NOTPAY/SUCCESS/REFUND/CLOSED/REVOKED/PAYERROR plus pay_type, pay_channel, trade_source_type, trade_no and cur_* currency columns, while NormalOrders (orders_normal_orders, numeric order_id PK) is the business order with independent order_status, pay_status, delivery_status, ziti_status, self_delivery_status, cancel_status, receipt_type and invoice_status columns; OrderAssociations (orders_associations) mirrors the order header across all order types so cross-type listing and payment guards work generically, and most state changes update both tables together.

Only NOTPAY trades may transition to SUCCESS: applyTradePaymentNotify persists the raw callback into trade.inital_response then re-reads and throws 更新已处理，不需要更新 unless the row is still NOTPAY; the internal finalizeTradeSuccess path guards the UPDATE with WHERE trade_state='NOTPAY' (true CAS) and re-publishes the trade-finish event idempotently when the trade is already SUCCESS; finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery applies the same CAS after a channel order query.

On trade SUCCESS the trade_no is assigned as a MMdd-seq suffix from a Redis daily sequence: h_trade_no_{company}_{distributor}_{MMdd} hash keyed by order id (86400s TTL) with c_trade_no_* counter backing it, generated identically by the notify path and the internal finalize path.

The trade-finish to order pay-success bridge (OrdersTradeFinishNormalOrderPaySuccessBridgeDispatchListener, registered sync at @Order(77) in bootstrap) calls markPayedIfNeeded which only handles trade_state=SUCCESS payloads whose trade_source_type is in NORMAL_TRADE_SOURCE_TYPES (normal, normal_normal, normal_groups, normal_seckill, normal_community, bargain, normal_shopguide, normal_pointsmall, normal_employee_purchase), targets WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS for normal_groups / PAYED otherwise except shopadmin-class orders which jump to DONE only when the order is NOT uses_platform_item_stock (cloud-warehouse fast-buy stays PAYED awaiting delivery), guards the update with order_status='NOTPAY' so zero rows means no pay-success event, mirrors the status onto orders_associations, promotes supplier_order children from NOTPAY/PART_PAYMENT for PAYED/DONE targets, and publishes event:288 NormalOrderPaySuccessEvent only when the order actually flipped.

Shopadmin/shopscreen self-pickup orders auto-complete on pay success: when receipt_type=ziti, markPayedIfNeeded marks non-logistics items delivered, sets ziti_status=DONE, and for pure non-logistics orders jumps the whole order to DONE with delivery_status=DONE and order_auto_close_aftersales_time derived from the platform latest_aftersale_time setting.

Wxapp order creation routes POST /order through WxappOrderCreateService.createOrder into WxappOrderTypeRegistry, which maps the order_type slug to one of 17 WxappOrderTypeCreateStrategy beans (normal, normal_groups, normal_seckill, bargain, normal_bargain, normal_pointsmall, normal_excard, normal_community, normal_shopguide, normal_shopadmin, normal_employee_purchase, normal_drug, service, service_groups, service_seckill, membercard, supplier_order) and throws 无此类型订单！ for unknown slugs; physical classes funnel into WxappPhysicalNormalOrderCreateSupport and the shared WxappNormalOrderCreateOrchestrator whose staged pipeline is validate, checkout-cart fill, store-adjust block, item/distributor check, format (coupon after freight), then one transactional runner.

OrderCreatePersistencePortImpl.persistOrder reuses a preassigned order_id from orderData (the shopadmin deferred orchestrator pre-assigns it via NormalOrderNumericIdService.generate) and only calls NormalOrderNumericIdService.generate(userId) as a fallback; when order_type or order_class is blank it derives them from OrderTypeSlugMapper.resolve on the order_type_slug (defaulting the slug to normal_shopadmin), takes shop_id from orderData (PHP _formatOrderData parity — shopInfo, 0 when isCheckShopValid=false, never rewritten to distributor_id, pinned by OrderCreatePersistencePortImplShopIdAlignPhpTest), applies currency fields via CompanyDefaultCurrencyService (company default fee_type/fee_rate/fee_symbol when orderData omits them), copies the shopadmin receiver_* address keys onto the order row (receiver_name truncated to 50 code points, applyReceiverFieldsFromOrderData) and normalizes uses_platform_item_stock to a persisted 0/1 flag, inserts NormalOrders + items (a uses_platform_item_stock order forces is_total_store on every line) + OrderPromotions + OrderAssociations + NormalOrdersRelSupplier rows from the supplier_freight_fee map, and stamps new rows order_status=NOTPAY, pay_status=NOTPAY, delivery_status=PENDING, cancel_status=NO_APPLY_CANCEL, ziti_status=NOTZITI, self_delivery_status=NOTMERCHANT.

The numeric order_id is generated by NormalOrderNumericIdService.generate(userId) from a Redis hash increment on a yyyyMMdd date key (companys Redis template, 1-day TTL): days-since-2012-01-01, minute-of-day divided by 90 (3 digits, capped 999), the 5-digit zero-padded hash value (incremented by a random 1-9 per call), and userId mod 10000 (4 digits).

SupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddService (lives in the ecshopx-orders module under the cn.shopex.ecshopx.supplier.service package, its own transaction) splits a newly created order into one supplier_order row per supplier sharing the parent order_id; payment, cancellation, and settlement all consult these children, and the pay-success bridge promotes them from NOTPAY/PART_PAYMENT to the order's target status.

POST /payment (WxappPaymentService.payment) rejects supplier_order type with 暂不支持该订单类型的支付, requires order_status NOTPAY or PART_PAYMENT (当前订单不需要支付), forces pay_type=point for zero-cash orders with points, guards prescription orders via OrderPrescriptionPaymentGuardService, and routes CZ-prefixed deposit orders to the deposit service; OrdersPaymentDoPaymentService.doPayment reuses a cached NOTPAY trade with payment_params for adapay/bspay instead of re-invoking the channel, inserts pending trades with encrypted mobile and currency conversion (pay_fee stored converted, original amounts in cur_pay_fee), and branches per pay_type: localPay/point/prepaid_point/deposit/pos finalize synchronously, bspay/adapay via the membercard SDK, wxpay*/alipay*/hfpay/offline_pay/paypal/doumen_intl via OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService, anything else throws 无此类型支付.

Point deduction happens exactly once across create and payment: pointsmall orders deduct order.point at create, so the payment path does not deduct again for trade_source_type=normal_pointsmall, and zero-cash orders with point deduction are forced to pay_type=point rather than localPay (source comment: 现金应付 0 且存在积分抵扣：按纯积分支付建单，避免落 localPay).

The auto-cancel cron family pages 20-at-a-time over NOTPAY orders whose string auto_cancel_time is due (CAST-computed against now+60s), scoped by order_class (cancel-orders covers normal/shopguide/employee_purchase, siblings handle groups, seckill, pointsmall, service-groups) and excluding offline_pay/point pay types; the offline variant additionally flips offline_payment.check_status=9 per order with per-order try/catch; beyond flipping order_status and associations to CANCEL each order runs a restore fan-out covering invoice and supplier-order cancellation, marketing join-count decrement, point/upoint return, OPL, per-item store and purchase-limit restores, limited-time-sale quota restores, and coupon/directed-promotion restore.

AdminNormalOrderFullCancelService is the shared whole-order cancel for admin, buyer and community chief: guards are cancel_status NO_APPLY_CANCEL or FAILS, order status NOTPAY/REVIEW_PASS/PAYED with delivery_status PENDING (with platform-self-sub and shop-remaining escape hatches), no approved drug order, and a cancellable dada rel row; the NOTPAY branch closes the order and restores points/upoints while the PAYED branch creates refund rows, sets cancel_status=WAIT_PROCESS and orders the after-commit TradeRefund fan-out before NormalOrderCancel so the refund dispatch lands first.

Confirm receipt (WxappNormalOrderConfirmReceiptService, shared with the admin surface and the finish-orders job) requires order_type=normal, order_status=WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM, delivery DONE/PARTAIL, and no item in aftersales_status WAIT_SELLER_AGREE/WAIT_BUYER_RETURN_GOODS/WAIT_SELLER_CONFIRM_GOODS (售后中的订单不能确认收货!); the transaction flips order, associations and supplier orders to DONE guarded by order_status='WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM' and stamps order_auto_close_aftersales_time = now + latest_aftersale_time days on header and lines, with after-commit effects covering supplier sync, OPL, chinaums division, bonus points, brokerage and profit close.

The finish-orders and consumption-orders crons do not process inline: scheduleFinishOrders publishes the FinishOrderJob (job:128, slow queue) each tick, and scheduleConsumptionOrders publishes ConsumptionOrderJob (job:129) but returns 0 without publishing when the ecshopx.request-field.oem-shuyun flag is true; the FinishOrderJobHandler path executes FinishOrderBatchService.runEquivalentToFinishOrderJobHandle, the same per-order semantics as interactive confirm-receipt.

Settlement statements are generated per merchant and per window: scheduleGenerateStatements pages distributors (platform product model only) and suppliers, resolves each merchant's statement period setting, computes the next window end from the Redis cursor, and dispatches one GenerateStatementsJob (job:118, slow queue) per merchant; StatementGenerateJobInliner runs one transaction per window, inserting the statements header, paging settled-eligible orders 500 at a time into statement_details (distributor fee = total minus refund minus intra-city freight minus cost, dada receipts counted as intra-city), marking consumed trades is_settled=true, and advancing the Redis cursor — a failure aborts only that merchant's window, leaving the cursor in place for the next tick to retry.

The fapiao crons over orders_invoice are: create-invoice selecting invoice_status=pending AND invoice_method=online rows dispatched per company with the apply_node invoice setting deciding the time constraint (order end time vs aftersales close time), query-invoice re-querying inProgress rows stale by 180 seconds, and query-invoice-red re-querying waste-status red-flush invoices missing invoice_file_url_red; job handlers call the Hangxin e-invoice gateway, red-flushing is also triggered from aftersales refunds via OrderInvoiceRedFromAftersalesPortImpl, and order cancellation cancels pending invoices via OrderInvoiceCancelOnOrderCancelService.

Local same-city delivery supports exactly two drivers selected by the common.local-delivery-dirver property (dada default, shansong alternative): LocalDeliveryBusinessReceiptService.businessReceipt branches on that property, calls the DadaLocalDeliveryReceiptPort or ShansongLocalDeliveryReceiptPort, updates the NormalOrdersRelDada row's dada_status=1 and publishes the shared 商家接单 OPL; full cancel refuses when the dada rel row is in a non-cancellable status (rider picked up).

The orders_cart table and CartController live in ecshopx-orders, but the read-heavy cart endpoints delegate through ports declared in orders/port whose implementations live elsewhere: WxappCartAddPort/WxappCartListPort (add, list, distributor cart list, cart count) are implemented in ecshopx-goods, while WxappCheckPlusItemPort (POST /cart/check/plusitem, records the chosen plus-buy SKU in the PlusBuyCartRedisKeys Redis bucket) and WxappCartGoodsPromotionApplyRulesPort (promotion re-check for PUT /cartupdate/promotion) are implemented in ecshopx-promotions — the documented pattern to avoid a direct orders-to-goods/promotions Maven dependency edge; local cart mutations (num update, batch num, check-status, delete, batch delete) stay in this bundle.

Order process logs (orders_process_log) are written through OrderProcessLogPublishPort (interface in ecshopx-common, implemented in ecshopx-dispatch with after-commit queueing via DispatchOptions.oplQueuedAfterCommit, inline when no transaction is active), consumed by OrderProcessLogDispatchListener into OrderProcessLogBusService.persistEntitiesMap; a secondary Spring path exists via OrderProcessLogSpringEventListener (@TransactionalEventListener AFTER_COMMIT, fallbackExecution=true), and the roughly 60 integration test classes named *OrderProcessLogEventAsyncConsumeTest / *OrderProcessLogDispatchPublishProbeTest pin the publish and async-consume envelope for every state-changing flow.

Orders publishes its cross-bundle state changes through the dispatch bus with constants catalogued in ecshopx-common OrdersDispatchEventNames (EVENT_TRADE_FINISH event:291 and the event:292 offline twin, EVENT_NORMAL_ORDER_PAY_SUCCESS event:288, EVENT_NORMAL_ORDER_ADD/CANCEL/DELIVERY/CONFIRM_RECEIPT, EVENT_WX_ORDER_SHIPPING, EVENT_ORDER_PROCESS_LOG) and job names in OrdersDispatchJobNames (FinishOrderJob job:128, ConsumptionOrderJob job:129, GenerateStatementsJob job:118, invoice jobs 124/125/126, SendPayOrdersRemindJob job:115, InvoiceRedJob job:20, TradeRefundStatistics job:66), with listeners registered in bootstrap *RegistrationConfig classes rather than annotation scanning.

All XXL-Job handlers in this bundle follow the same envelope: @XxlJob(handler-short-name) execute() calls the service, logs, and on exception publishes a CronAlertEvent then rethrows, so a failing tick surfaces in the alert pipeline and XXL-Job's own retry semantics.

Aftersales interlock on orders: the header's left_aftersales_num is the remaining quota aftersales decrements, item-level aftersales_status and delivery_status/delivery_item_num track per-line state, and confirm receipt is blocked while any line sits in an active aftersales status — the refund-execution half of this contract lives in the aftersales bundle.

The admin 代客下单 create pipeline defers all persistence: POST /api/v1/order/create → NormalOrderAdminCreateUserOrderService.createUserOrder → ShopadminNormalOrderCreateOrchestrator.create runs the shared staged pipeline (normal_shopadmin only, need-params → operator-cart fill → item check → distributor check → format → assertDepositBalance) but calls only preparePricingSnapshot (the non-transactional pricing half: cross-border identity CN-ID-card validation, point-deduct formatting, markdown, pre-persist enrichment), then pre-assigns the order_id and writes a ShopadminDeferredOrderSnapshot with status WAIT_PAY to Redis under shopadmin:deferred:{companyId}:{orderId} with TTL = auto_cancel_time − now (15 × 60 s fallback) — no DB persist and no normal_order_add publish on create, pinned by the two NormalOrderAddDispatchPublishProbe tests.

ShopadminNormalOrderCreateTransactionalRunner splits the wxapp transaction in two: preparePricingSnapshot is non-transactional (cross-border identity, point-deduct format, markdown, pre-persist enrichment), while persistPreparedSnapshot is @Transactional and runs OrderCreatePersistencePort.persistOrder → OrderCreateInventoryPort.minusStores → OrderCreatePostCommitPort.runAfterOrderInsert in one transaction; the deferred pipeline calls the two halves at different times (pricing before the Redis snapshot write, persistence only after payment succeeds).

NormalOrderController (admin /api/v1, @AdminAuth, route aliases order.checkout / order.create / order.payment / order.payment.query) exposes the shopadmin POS surface: POST /checkout (NormalOrderAdminCheckoutService.checkout, the confirmation preview that runs the same pipeline and ShopadminNormalOrderTempInfoEnrichmentService without persisting), POST /order/create (代客下单, deferred snapshot only), POST /order/payment (下单支付, NormalOrderAdminPaymentService.payment), GET /order/payment/query (支付结果查询, NormalOrderAdminPaymentQueryService.queryPayment with trade_id required and 支付单号不存在 on blank/0); company_id and operator_id come from the operator JWT.

NormalOrderAdminPaymentService.payment is the bridge between the deferred and ordinary pay paths: it requires pay_type or auth_code (支付方式必填), classifies an auth_code by regex (18-digit 1[0-5]… → wxpaypos, 25–30 prefix → alipaypos, default pay_type wxpayh5), and when orders_associations has no row for the company+order but the deferred cache does, it delegates to ShopadminDeferredOrderService.payDeferredOrder; with an association row present it runs the ordinary admin guards (supplier_order rejection, NOTPAY/PART_PAYMENT, effective-type check, zero-cash point forcing, pay-type persist, prescription/deposit/alipaymini guards) and calls doPayment directly.

ShopadminDeferredOrderService.payDeferredOrder restricts deferred payment to DEFERRED_PAY_TYPES (pos, wxpaypos, alipaypos — 暂不支持该支付方式 otherwise, REFUNDED snapshots answer 订单已退款) and executes under the shopadmin:deferred:lock:{orderId} Redis lock; in order it recovers an already-materialized order (markPayedIfNeeded when still NOTPAY plus supplier re-split), materializes from an already-paid SUCCESS trade (a REFUND trade answers 订单已退款), and otherwise calls doPayment with data rebuilt from the snapshot (trade_source_type=normal, pay_fee=snapshot totalFee, auth_code forwarded) — a non-true pay_status returns the channel result with the snapshot left WAIT_PAY.

On doPayment success the deferred pipeline materializes exactly once: persistAndFinishAfterPay runs persistPreparedSnapshot (persistOrder + minusStores + runAfterOrderInsert in one transaction), then OrdersTradeFinishNormalOrderPaySuccessApplyService.markPayedIfNeeded on a snake_case view of the trade (same NOTPAY-guarded CAS as the bridge; shopadmin orders jump straight to DONE and the ziti auto-complete closes non-logistics orders), then supplier split plus a single normal_order_add publish, then deletes the cache entry — for shopadmin orders normal_order_add is therefore published at materialization (payment), never at create.

Deferred failure semantics after a successful charge: a ResourceException from materialization triggers a channel refund (WxpaySecapiAftersalesRefundRunner for wxpay*, AlipayTradeAftersalesRefundRunner for alipay* with SUCCESS or PROCESSING counted as success, pos treated as refunded), a CAS trade flip SUCCESS→REFUND (WHERE trade_state='SUCCESS'), and snapshot status REFUNDED — or REFUND_FAILED when the channel refund fails; any other RuntimeException parks the snapshot as PAID_WAIT_ORDER and surfaces 订单创建失败，请稍后查询 (money held, not refunded); every non-WAIT_PAY outcome is rewritten with the 24h COMPENSATION_TTL_SECONDS so recovery stays possible.

GET /order/payment/query is the deferred recovery leg: NormalOrderAdminPaymentQueryService.queryPayment resolves the trade through OrdersPaymentTradeQueryService.resolve (SUCCESS trades answer directly, otherwise the channel is queried and a confirmed success is finalized via finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery), then for a SUCCESS trade calls supplementAfterPaymentQuery, which recovers an existing order (markPayedIfNeeded when still NOTPAY, then re-split), refunds an orphaned charge whose snapshot is gone, retries a REFUND_FAILED snapshot under the lock, or materializes the order from the still-cached snapshot.

The shopadmin create param builder fixes the 代客下单 semantics (promotion=normal, order_source=shop_offline, is_online_order=false, receipt_type=ziti flipped to logistics when cart_type=fastbuy, order_type=normal_shopadmin, source_from=dianwu, pay_type defaulting to pos, the seven receiver_* address keys copied into params when present) and pre-validates markdown via ShopadminNormalOrderMarkdownValidator (改价参数格式错误 / 确认整单还是按件改价 / 整单改价金额必填 / 按件改价商品ID必填 / 按件改价商品总价和折扣必须设置一个), resolving user_id to a member row via MemberLookupByUserIdOnlyService and copying mobile/appids into params; the operator cart itself is owned by companys (OperatorCartController with POST /cartfastbuyadd 店务立即购买（云仓分桶） plus cartdata add/update/list/delete and scancodeAddcart, over operator_cart and the OperatorShopFastBuyRedisService shop_fastbuy: bucket in companys Redis, 600 s TTL), read through the goods-implemented OperatorCartDataListFacade / OperatorCartFastBuyFacade and filled into the create state by OrderCheckoutCartPort.fillItemsFromOperatorCart — which branches on cart_type=fastbuy before the ordinary operator-cart read: DistributorPlatformStoreBuyGateService.assertShopadminPlatformStoreBuyAllowed (立即购买需指定有效店铺 / 无效店铺 / 该店铺未开启云仓可购买), then revalidateFastBuyPlatformStock (立即购买已失效，请重新加购 for a stale bucket), then getFastBuyCartDataList; both paths take checked rows from the first valid_cart block (购物车为空 when none) and are emptied at materialization by runAfterOrderInsert.

The order-create pipeline stages are cross-bundle ports declared in ecshopx-common/order/normal and implemented outside orders: OrderCreateNeedParamsPort, OrderCheckoutCartPort (operator/member/distributor/pointsmall/groups carts), OrderCreateItemCheckPort, OrderCreateFormatDataPort (with assertDepositBalance and applyCheckoutCouponAfterFreight; format stamps uses_platform_item_stock=1 only for shopadmin + cart_type=fastbuy and passes through the shopadmin receiver_* address keys) and OrderCreateInventoryPort (a uses_platform_item_stock order forces is_total_store on every line, making the platform bucket the deduction target) are implemented in ecshopx-goods, OrderCreateDistributorCheckPort in ecshopx-distribution (店铺不存在或已失效, 该门店不支持自提) — the wxapp and shopadmin orchestrators inject the same port beans, which is what makes the 代客下单 pipeline a stage-for-stage reuse of the wxapp semantics; OrderTypeSlugMapper in ecshopx-common is the shared slug → order_type/order_class contract between both create chains, cron scoping and list filters.

ShopadminDeferredOrderCache persists the deferred create state in shared Redis (sharedStringRedisTemplate) as a JSON ShopadminDeferredOrderSnapshot (orderId, companyId, status, payType, totalFee, tradeId, createdAt, expireAt, params, orderData) under shopadmin:deferred:{companyId}:{orderId} with opsForValue().set and a per-status TTL; reads treat a corrupt JSON blob as a miss and surface Redis failures as ResourceException (订单缓存不可用 / 订单缓存写入失败), and withLock guards pay/materialize/refund transitions with setIfAbsent on shopadmin:deferred:lock:{orderId} (UUID token, 120 s TTL, token-checked best-effort unlock, 订单处理中，请稍后查询 on contention).

OrdersPaymentTradeQueryService.resolve drives GET /order/payment/query: a missing/blank trade_id or unknown trade answers 支付单不存在, an already-SUCCESS trade returns 支付成功 directly, and any other trade is queried at the channel (wxpay pay/orderquery, Alipay openapi, doumen) — a channel-confirmed SUCCESS is finalized through finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery before the merged result (channel keys plus trade_id/pay_type) is returned; channel query failures surface as 支付失败.

The wxpaypos and alipaypos channels are synchronous barcode payments built in OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService: wxpaypos sends a WeChat V2 micropay (requires auth_code, 缺少付款码 otherwise) and returns pay_status=true with transaction_id when the channel confirms; alipaypos calls tradePayBarcodeFaceToFace and maps Alipay code 10000 to pay_status=true/status SUCCESS, 10003 to USERPAYING (pending), invalid-barcode sub-codes to BadRequest and anything else to ResourceException — which is why doPayment finalizes the trade only when the client result carries pay_status=true.

For shopadmin-class orders the pay-success bridge targets DONE rather than PAYED only when the order is NOT uses_platform_item_stock (cloud-warehouse fast-buy stays PAYED awaiting delivery; normal_groups → WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS, otherwise PAYED, guarded by order_status='NOTPAY' on the main row so zero rows means no event), and ziti shopadmin/shopscreen orders auto-complete (maybeAutoCompleteShopadminOrShopscreenZiti fires for order_class=shopadmin or is_shopscreen=true with pay_status=PAYED and receipt_type=ziti): non-logistics items are marked delivered with delivery_item_num=num and auto_close_aftersales_time derived from the platform latest_aftersale_time setting via OrderValiditySettingRedisReadService, ziti_status=DONE, pure non-logistics orders jump the whole order to DONE with delivery_status=DONE, delivery_time, end_time and left_aftersales_num summed from the lines, and a logistics order with any delivered non-logistics line only flips delivery_status=PARTAIL.

OrderCreatePostCommitPortImpl.runAfterOrderInsert empties the cart per order-type: employee-purchase orders via the employee-purchase port; normal_shopadmin + cart_type=fastbuy orders via OperatorCartFastBuyFacade.clearFastBuyCart (the operator cloud fast-buy bucket); normal_shopadmin otherwise by deleting operator_cart rows per item via OperatorCartDeleteDataService.delCartData; community/excard orders skip; a member cart_type=fastbuy clears the Redis fastbuy:{sha1(companyId+userId)} key (writing [] with a 600 s TTL); and the default path deletes orders_cart rows matching company+user+shop(distributor_id) for the ordered item ids; it also skips saving the ziti relation for shopadmin and community classes.

OrderCreatePostCommitPortImpl publishes the creation OPL and the pay-remind job from the persist transaction: the OPL payload uses operator_type=user with the orderData user_id as operator_id (not the staff operator), remarks 订单创建 with detail 订单号：{orderId}，订单创建 for normal orders and 订单核销/订单核销成功 for excard, and the full params map; the pay-remind payload carries order_id, company_id, user_id, appid/open_id, total_fee, title, fee fields and auto_cancel_time, aligned with WxappOrderCreateService — both pinned by OrderCreatePostCommitPortImplNormalOrderCreateUserOrderOrderProcessLogDispatchPublishProbeTest and OrderCreatePostCommitPortImplSendPayRemindTest.

The auto-cancel time for a new order is resolved from the platform order_cancel_time setting (order validity Redis settings) with a 15-minute default, except offline/offline_pay pay types which get a 365-day window; ShopadminNormalOrderTempInfoEnrichmentService (checkout preview) and NormalOrderCreatePrePersistEnrichmentService (pre-persist) apply the same rule, and OrderCreatePersistencePortImpl falls back to now + 15 × 60 only when the field is still missing.

NormalOrderAdminCheckoutService.checkout (POST /api/v1/checkout, 购物车结算) is the shopadmin confirmation preview: it reuses NormalOrderAdminCreateUserOrderParamBuilder.build, rejects any order_type other than normal_shopadmin (无此类型订单！), runs need-params → operator-cart fill → item check → distributor check → format, then applies cross-border identity, point-deduct formatting and markdown inline, and returns ShopadminNormalOrderTempInfoEnrichmentService.apply — which pre-assigns an order_id and auto_cancel_time into orderData for display without persisting anything.

AdminNormalOrderDeliveryCoreService (the shared core behind admin POST /delivery and PUT /order/updateDelivery) fires a delivery-success notify hook after the delivery write: sendDeliveryNotices calls OrderDeliverySuccessNotifyPort.sendDeliverySuccessNotice once per shipment, or once per item with item_name for a sep (per-package) delivery. The port has two impls selected by ecshopx.orders.delivery-success-notify.enabled: the wechat impl (default on, matchIfMissing=true) builds the orderDeliverySucc subscribe-message payload — recipient (wxa_appid + openId) from OrderTradeMiniProgramRecipientLookupPort, item_name falling back to the order title, courier display name — and sends it through OrderDeliverySuccessWxaSubscribeSendPort (implemented in promotions), mirroring the PHP AbstractNormalOrder::sendDeliverySucc contract and swallowing failures at debug; the NoOp impl (havingValue=false) sends nothing.

CartController's front surface spans add (POST /cart), list (GET /cart), the @FrontNoAuth distributor cart list (GET /cart/list, company id from claims then the H5 company attribute else 未授权, falsy user_id short-circuits to an empty list except cart_type=offline), cartdel, cartdelbat, checkstatus, batchnum, num, promotion, cartcount and the plusitem check (POST /cart/check/plusitem). Every authed endpoint resolves the claim map from the wxapp request attribute falling back to the H5 claims else throws UnauthorizedException(未登录); GET /cartcount throws BadRequestException(参数非法) on a blank shop_type and defaults cart_type=cart; PUT /cartupdate/batchnum throws BadRequestException(参数非法) when cart is missing, not a list, or an entry is not a map (empty list returns [] without calling the service); WxappCartParamMergeSupport applies the buy-on-behalf rule on add (promoter_user_id == session user_id and non-zero → user_id becomes buy_user_id) while checkstatus applies the simpler unconditional rule (buy_user_id non-zero replaces the auth user); the shop filter accepts shop_id or distributor_id and treats undefined/blank/0 as unset.
